limitations: Synthetic images and geometry do not establish field recognition rate or robustness.
CPU timings are observations of these builds. Compiler flags, CPU dispatch and packaging are not fully controlled; timing percentages cannot be attributed causally to the OpenCV version.
Native version/dependency identity must be checked externally (for example otool); the public C ABI does not expose a runtime version or thread-count getter.
